name: request_security_expression_context_capture
source: Pyne-defined request.security requested-context expression capture fixture
script:
indicator("Request Expression Context Capture", overlay=True)
expr_mid, expr_conditional, expr_prev_body = request.security(
    "BTCUSDT",
    "240",
    lambda ctx: (
        (ctx.high + ctx.low) / 2,
        ctx.when(ctx.close > ctx.open, ctx.high, ctx.low),
        ctx.close[1] - ctx.open[1],
    ),
    gaps=barmerge.gaps_on,
)
provider_time, provider_open, provider_high, provider_low, provider_close, provider_volume = request.security(
    "BTCUSDT",
    "240",
    ("time", "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"),
    gaps=barmerge.gaps_on,
)
plot(expr_mid, "Expr Mid")
plot(expr_conditional, "Expr Conditional")
plot(expr_prev_body, "Expr Previous Body")
plot(provider_time, "Expr Provider Time")
plot(provider_open, "Expr Open")
plot(provider_high, "Expr High")
plot(provider_low, "Expr Low")
plot(provider_close, "Expr Provider Close")
plot(provider_volume, "Expr Volume")
